title: Metadata
intro: Configure how Feylore discovers and resolves metadata for each media type.
fileMetadataHelp: Choose where Feylore persists canonical metadata after it is updated.
metadataPersistence_write_to_file_descri: Write Feylore metadata into EPUB or OPF when the format supports it.
metadataPersistence_write_to_sidecar_des: Leave the original file untouched and write metadata to a Feylore sidecar.
metadataPersistence_neither_description: Keep metadata in Feylore only. Do not write back to files or sidecars.
provenanceNote: User-edited metadata and field overrides are preserved during metadata refresh. Changing source order does not overwrite manually curated values.
sourceOrderHelp: Determines preferred source when multiple providers supply metadata and helps resolve conflicts.
fillMissing: Fill missing values from lower-priority sources
respectOverrides: User field overrides are always respected
noModules: No media modules are enabled. Enable modules under Settings → General.
generalModulesHelp: Choose which media types are active in your library. Metadata settings appear only for enabled modules.
featureModulesHelp: Turn instance-wide features on or off. Disabling a module stops its processing and hides its surfaces; earned data is kept and restored when re-enabled.
warningsProvenanceNotice: Warnings come from the indicated source and have not been independently verified by Feylore.
